title: Recursive Factorial
description: Read an integer n and print n! (n factorial), computed with a RECURSIVE function: n! is 1 when n is 0, otherwise n times (n-1)!. The base case must be reachable and every call must shrink toward it; a missing base case recurses forever and never returns. This problem establishes the C8 base skill of recursive decomposition with base and progress cases.
